#!/bin/bash
wump_evidence=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-local-lookup
wump_stock=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-7a16547/stock/perl/perl-5.42.2/perl
wump_go=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-runtime-owner/integration/matrix-go
wump_after="$wump_evidence/integration/perl/perl-5.42.2/perl"
export LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Refusing timing capture with dirty sources.' >&2; exit 1; fi
if ! taskset -c 0,2,4,6 perl bench/matrix.pl "$wump_after" "$wump_stock" "$wump_go" --runs 5 --iterations 50000 --jobs 8 --output "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.md" 2> "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.stderr"; then
 printf '%s\n' 'Matrix capture failed.' >&2; exit 1
fi
perl bench/matrix-check.pl bench/operation-matrix-xs-current.json "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-check.txt"
wump_fresh=$?
perl bench/matrix-check.pl bench/operation-matrix-callee-baseline.json "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-anchor-check.txt"
wump_anchor=$?
perl bench/matrix-check.pl bench/operation-matrix-select-current.json "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-pre-xs-check.txt"
wump_pre_xs=$?
printf 'Previous XS gate exit: %s; retained-anchor gate exit: %s; pre-XS selection gate exit: %s\n' "$wump_fresh" "$wump_anchor" "$wump_pre_xs"
if [ "$wump_fresh" -ne 0 ] || [ "$wump_anchor" -ne 0 ] || [ "$wump_pre_xs" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
diagnostic_note: Preserved exploratory three-run, 5000-iteration JSON probes are not regression gates; intermediate after binaries were not frozen. The standard matrix is the clean-source final measurement.

machine.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 4750U with Radeon Graphics

matrix_note: The preceding XS capture is reused as a frozen control. Primary fixtures, Wump.pm, stock/Go binaries, CPU mask and parameters are unchanged. Both captures have 770 samples, including 650 successful samples. The default retained anchor is unchanged; a third report checks the pre-XS selection capture.
validation_note:
Source eecbbcd46ea005a11ecfbc70ccfe6f12299c5820 was committed and clean before
standard timing. Source changes are Perl-for-Wump binding selection/creation
and serial validation, with a separate hash-key temporary ownership fix.
No benchmark workload, Wump.pm, stock/Go control, affinity or timing parameter
changed. The subsequent documentation cleanup changes Makefile baseline names
and the legacy checker fixture path, without changing either baseline's bytes.

The normal and ASan complete perl-test targets pass. ASan uses
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:detect_stack_use_after_return=1,
PERL_DESTRUCT_LEVEL=2, PERL_SANITIZER=address and matching -fsanitize=address
runtime compile/link flags. Whole-core TSan scoped suites pass:
hash-key-temporaries 8, local-lookup 8, json-parallel 18, utf8-xs 16,
caller-parallel 12, element-mark-parallel 4, gv-parallel 4, parallel 56.
The TSan native C/C++ lookup fixture passes on one/four slots, and the
allocator fixture detects the deliberate Perl_more_bodies race. Scoped LSan
passes hash-key/local/JSON/caller/UTF8 and native C/C++ one/four slots with
full teardown. Source/archive integrity checks cover all six runtime members
in normal, ASan and TSan archives. Context/legacy stock differentials pass
53/26 assertions. Selected upstream tests pass 12 files/2000 assertions.
Parser regeneration passes with Bison 3.8.2. Live Mojolicious 9.37 external
HTTP/WebSocket suites pass 48 assertions each on one/four slots.

Negative controls: preceding frozen build fails C four-slot zero-mutex
private lookup. On that build, new hash-key TSan suite fails four of eight
assertions (read/write TEMP flag race); new local-lookup suite fails two of
eight under TSan. Initial TSan failures, initial C++ XS declaration compile
failure (corrected using XS_INTERNAL), intermediate exploratory triage and
an unsuccessful debugger attempt are retained as diagnostic logs, not passes.
No fresh full upstream, complete project TSan or whole-upstream sanitizer is
claimed. Existing full-TSan ithreads clone and MSan locale/toolchain limits
remain unresolved. Test2 runtime compilation remains rejected on multi-slot
execution; no compiler/XS gate was relaxed.

Final standard capture: 770 observations, 650 successful, five rotated runs,
50000 iterations, eight jobs, CPU affinity 0,2,4,6. Preceding XS comparison
passes; retained default-anchor comparison passes. Pre-XS selection comparison
still fails one-slot JSON work +10.64% and process +10.61%. The runner returns
1 because that historical gate fails; no retry, rebaseline or test weakening
clears it. Exact extra comparisons are embedded with their historical Git
paths and hashes. Superseded capture files are retrieved using git show at
source eecbbcd; the embedded capture runner reflects original filenames.
Current JSON work is 48948.4/44104.0/42329.5 ns on one/two/four slots, compared
with approximately 53740/53480/53640 ns in the preceding XS build. Scaling
remains weak. Default-anchor JSON two/four slots are newly supported cells,
not established timing regressions/improvements relative to unsupported work.

Cleanup removes superseded generated reports instead of relocating them into
an archive. Active matrix baseline (formerly callee-baseline), integer baseline
(formerly perl-scalar-after) and legacy schema fixture (formerly perl-active-after)
are preserved byte-for-byte under stable names. The checker regression suites
pass 89 baseline and 134 matrix assertions; worker integration passes 477.
Current docs replace dated checkpoint narratives; durable API and invariant
references remain. The current matrix, report, gate and retained inputs are
hashed separately from captured-source artifacts. Detailed logs/builds remain
local in master/build/checkpoint-local-lookup; Git retains previous snapshots.
